conversation.Statement: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Collins? My name is Rebecca from Amazon Account Security. I'm reaching out because we noticed an unusual charge on your account this morning.
Oh dear, yes, this is Evelyn Collins. What sort of charge are you talking about?

Thank you for confirming, Mrs. Collins. There appears to be a new subscription for a streaming service added to your Amazon account, totaling $119.99. We wanted to check if you authorized this purchase.
No, I absolutely did not! I'm on a fixed income. I can't afford anything extra right now.

I completely understand your concern, and I assure you we'll do everything to resolve this. For your protection, could you please verify the last four digits of your phone number and your email address tied to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 2934, and my email is e.collins1950@gmail.com.
Thank you, Mrs. Collins. That matches our records. It looks like your account may have been compromised. To fix this, I'll walk you through a quick verification process, if that's alright.
Yes, please help. I can't afford to lose any money.
Not to worry, you're in safe hands. First, I need to confirm your home address for account recovery purposes.
It's 1442 Maple Drive, Springfield, Illinois.
Thank you very much. Now, to secure your account and block unauthorized access, we'll need to verify your recent activity using a secure connection. Are you near your computer or tablet right now?
Yes, my laptop is open.
Excellent. Please open your browser and go to www.quickassistsupport.com. This is our Amazon security portal, and it will allow us to check your account together safely.
I see the page. It's asking for a code.
Perfect. I'll generate your secure code now. Please enter 332-899 into the box and click 'Connect.'
Alright, it says 'waiting for technician.'
That's exactly right. This gives us a protected view of your account, just for verification, I promise. You'll see everything I do on your screen.
Okay, I see a window popping up.

Now, I'm going to check your account history. It looks like that unauthorized subscription began a refund process, but due to a technical error, a refund of $1,200 was just sent to your bank account instead of the $120 you were owed.
Oh my goodness, that's a lot more than I should get! I don't want any trouble.

No worries at all, Mrs. Collins. Mistakes like this sometimes happen with automated refunds. All you need to do is return the extra funds to us, and we'll finalize the refund for the correct amount. You won't be at risk as long as we correct this quickly.
How do I send the money back? I don't want to do anything wrong.

You're doing everything right. The most efficient way is through Amazon's partnered gift card system. If you purchase $1,080 in Amazon gift cards at a local store, we can process the return immediately and ensure your account is credited for the original refund amount.
I've never bought that many gift cards before. Are you sure that's safe?

Absolutely. This is a temporary step just to reverse the error. As soon as you send us the gift card numbers, the balance will be applied directly back to Amazon's system and your bank statement will show the correction within the next business day.
Okay, I'll go to the store now. Should I call you when I return?

Yes, please give us a call as soon as you have the cards. I'll stay on the line if you'd like, or you can call our direct line at 1-844-221-6600. We only have a limited time before the banking system flags this as an error, so it's best to act quickly.
Alright, I'll head out now and get the gift cards.
Thank you, Mrs. Collins. I know this is inconvenient, but you're helping us protect your account. Once you're back, I'll guide you on how to provide the numbers safely.
I'm back with the cards. I got six $200 cards.
Excellent. When you're ready, please read each card number aloud, and I'll enter them securely into our refund system.
Okay, the first one is 6378 2920 1123 4456...
Thank you, Mrs. Collins. Please continue with the next card.
Perfect. I've entered those. Keep going until all are completed.
That's all six cards.
You did wonderfully. The excess refund will now be reversed, and you'll see only the correct $120 credit on your bank statement within 48 hours. Is there anything else I can answer for you?
No, I just hope this all works out. Thank you for being so patient with me.
It's my pleasure, Mrs. Collins. You've helped resolve this quickly and safely. If you have any worries, feel free to call our support line at any time. Have a lovely rest of your day!
